question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Beloved, Bob gets Dune, and Claire gets Ivanhoe.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Bob and Claire swap books. Then, Bob and Alice swap books. Finally, Claire and Alice swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Beloved
(B) Dune
(C) Ivanhoe
solution:
Books in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (Beloved, Dune, Ivanhoe)
1. Bob and Claire swap: (Beloved, Ivanhoe, Dune)
2. Bob and Alice swap: (Ivanhoe, Beloved, Dune)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (Dune, Beloved, Ivanhoe)
Alice has Dune, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
